payload.name: Recall.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Investigate meeting bots, recordings, transcripts, calendars, logs, webhooks, service health, and API documentation from your Recall.ai workspaces.
payload.longDescription: 从您的Recall.ai工作区中调查会议机器人、录音、文字记录、日历、日志、网络钩子、服务健康状态和API文档。

payload.name: worklore
payload.description: 开发者故事库，能力透视
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: worklore is a library of honest, agent-reproducible developer stories. Search stories and open their machine-readable "Reproduce this" contract so your agent can run the same fix in your own project; x-ray any skill or story to see what it can actually do (a capability tier T0-T4 bound to the content hash) before you run it; and record how a reproduction honestly went. Sign in with GitHub or Google.
payload.longDescription: Worklore 是一个包含真实可由代理复现的开发者故事的库。搜索故事并打开其可被机器读取的「复现此操作」合约，以便您的代理可在您自己的项目中运行相同的修复方案；在运行前，通过透视任何技能或故事，查看其实际功能（能力等级 T0-T4，与内容哈希绑定）；并记录复现过程的真实情况。使用 GitHub 或 Google 登录。

payload.name: VirusTotal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Investigate files, URLs, domains and IP addresses with VirusTotal threat intelligence. Read existing reports and interpret detections together with analysis dates and coverage. A missing report is an unknown result, not a safety verdict.

Analyze an explicitly authorized ChatGPT attachment using its original file object, or supply a small file as explicit bytes. VTAI hashes the original content and uploads it only after confirming that VirusTotal does not already know it. Contributing a new file does not spend report-query quota. Retrieving an existing report, including repeated lookups and analysis-status reads, consumes query quota; receipt recovery is free. File contributions have separate abuse limits.

For authorized network analysis, submit a URL or request domain/IP reanalysis. Keep each request ID, recover its receipt after an interruption, and follow its registered analysis without repeating an uncertain submission.

Connect with Google sign-in through VirusTotal AI (VTAI); no VirusTotal API key is required. Permissions and quotas apply to your account across connections. Revoke access from VTAI at any time.

Standard submissions are shared with VirusTotal and may be available to its security community and partners. Ask before sharing personal documents, internal code, credentials or personal data. Complete URLs, including query strings and fragments, are disclosed. The remote connector cannot read local filesystem paths. Report evidence does not guarantee safety.
payload.longDescription:
通过VirusTotal威胁情报调查文件、网址、域名和IP地址。查看现有报告并结合分析日期和覆盖范围解读检测结果。缺失报告表示未知结果，而非安全判定。

通过其原始文件对象显式授权分析ChatGPT附件，或直接提供小文件字节数据。VTAI会哈希原始内容，并在确认VirusTotal尚未收录该内容后才进行上传。贡献新文件不会消耗报告查询配额。获取现有报告（包括重复查询和分析状态读取）会消耗查询配额；接收恢复免费。文件贡献有独立的滥用限制。

对于已授权的网络分析，提交网址或请求重新分析域名/IP。保留每个请求ID，在中断后恢复凭证，并跟踪已注册的分析过程，避免重复不确定的提交。

通过VirusTotal AI（VTAI）使用谷歌账号登录；无需VirusTotal API密钥。您的账户在所有连接中均适用权限和配额限制。可随时撤销VTAI的访问权限。

标准提交内容会与VirusTotal共享，可能向其安全社区和合作伙伴开放。分享个人文档、内部代码、凭证或个人数据前请先征得同意。完整网址（包括查询字符串和片段）将被披露。远程连接器无法读取本地文件系统路径。报告证据不保证安全性。

payload.name: Protogrid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Protogrid is a public registry of MCP servers. Describe a task in plain words and it finds matching servers from the official MCP registry, tells you how each one connects (no sign-in, an API key, OAuth or a local package), and returns a ready-to-use configuration for clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or VS Code. Every server shows its tools, a change history of its tool definitions, and trust and quality scores built from our own credential-free checks. You can also check any remote MCP server URL for protocol support and directory readiness. protogrid is read-only: it never calls third-party tools and never asks for your credentials. Scores come from observable signals; no audit is implied.
payload.longDescription: Protogrid是MCP服务器的公共注册表。用普通文字描述任务，它将从官方MCP注册表中查找匹配的服务器，告知每个服务器的连接方式（无需登录、API密钥、OAuth或本地包），并为Claude Code、Codex、Cursor或VS Code等客户端返回即用型配置。每个服务器会显示其工具、工具定义的变更历史，以及通过我们自主的无凭证检测生成的信任和质量评分。您还可以检查任何远程MCP服务器URL的协议支持和目录就绪状态。Protogrid是只读的：它从不调用第三方工具，也从不请求您的凭证。评分来自可观察的信号；不表示任何审计。

payload.name: GitDiagram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GitDiagram shows how a public GitHub repository is built. Ask about a repository, for example "Show me the architecture of fastapi/fastapi", and you get its architecture diagram: an interactive map of the main components and how they connect, which you can pan, zoom and open full screen, and where every component opens its source code on GitHub.

With the diagram, ChatGPT also receives GitDiagram's written explanation of how the codebase is organized, the list of components with the paths they live in, how they connect, and the Mermaid source, so it can answer follow-up questions about the code and point you to the right files.

You can also search GitDiagram's library of diagrams by owner or repository name, and get a repository's narrated explainer video and its transcript when one exists.

It's for anyone getting to know an unfamiliar codebase: onboarding to a project, evaluating an open-source dependency, preparing a first contribution, or explaining how a project works.

Limitations: GitDiagram covers public GitHub repositories only. The plugin reads diagrams GitDiagram has already made; when a repository has none yet, it gives you a link to gitdiagram.com, where the diagram is made in about a minute, and after that the plugin can read it. Diagrams are AI-generated from the repository's files and can miss details, so check anything important against the code. The plugin is read-only, never changes anything on GitHub or elsewhere, and needs no account.
payload.longDescription:
GitDiagram展示公共GitHub仓库的构建方式。例如输入「显示fastapi/fastapi的架构图」，您将获得该仓库的架构图：一个交互式地图，展示主要组件及其连接方式，可进行平移、缩放和全屏查看，每个组件均可打开其在GitHub上的源代码。

通过该图表，ChatGPT还能获得GitDiagram对代码库组织方式的文字说明、包含路径的组件列表、组件间连接关系以及Mermaid源代码，从而能回答关于代码的后续问题并指引正确文件。

您还可以通过负责人或仓库名称搜索GitDiagram的图表库，当存在对应仓库的讲解视频时，还能获取该仓库的语音解说视频及其文字稿。

适用于任何需要了解陌生代码库的人群：项目入职、评估开源依赖项、准备首次贡献或解释项目运作方式时。

限制条件：GitDiagram仅支持公共GitHub仓库。插件读取GitDiagram已生成的图表；若仓库尚未生成图表，会提供跳转至gitdiagram.com的链接，该网站可在约1分钟内生成图表，之后插件即可读取。图表由AI根据仓库文件生成，可能遗漏细节，因此重要信息请对照代码核实。插件为只读模式，从不在GitHub或其他地方修改内容，且无需账户。

payload.name: Prerender Buddy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Prerender Buddy helps users inspect public crawler-readable HTML and review read-only website health, crawler activity, AI visibility, recommendations, and content status from an authorized workspace.
payload.longDescription: Prerender Buddy 使用户能够检查公共爬虫可读 HTML，并从授权工作区审查只读网站健康状况、爬虫活动、AI可见性、建议和内容状态。

payload.name: Youmake
payload.description: 构建网站、应用和幻灯片
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Youmake is a development workspace for creating and editing websites, mobile apps, and slide decks from natural-language instructions. It helps founders, designers, and developers turn project briefs into working software and presentations.

Connect your Youmake account to open projects you are authorized to access. Describe a new project or request changes through ChatGPT’s message box. Follow the coding agent in Chat logs, inspect the embedded preview, and stop an active build when needed.

Publish websites and slide projects to a Youmake subdomain or a domain you own after confirming the destination. Custom domains require DNS configuration. Mobile device testing and app-store publishing continue in the Youmake editor.
payload.longDescription:
Youmake是用于通过自然语言指令创建和编辑网站、移动应用及幻灯片演示文稿的开发工作台。它帮助创始人、设计师和开发人员将项目需求转化为可运行的软件和演示文稿。

将您的Youmake账户连接至您有权限访问的开放项目。通过ChatGPT的消息框描述新项目或提出修改请求。在聊天记录中跟踪编码代理的操作，查看嵌入式预览，并在需要时中止当前构建过程。

确认目标地址后，可将网站和幻灯片项目发布到Youmake子域名或您拥有的域名。自定义域名需要配置DNS。移动设备测试和应用商店发布仍将在Youmake编辑器中进行。

payload.name: Superlog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect the Slack channels where errors arrive and the repositories your team works on. Superlog investigates reports, opens bugfix pull requests when it can verify a fix, and replies in the original thread with its findings.

Describe what you want to automate, and we’ll walk you through getting started—from creating your Superlog account to connecting your tools and activating your first automation. You can also set up scheduled reliability checks, Sentry issue triage, and support workflows.

Connect an existing Superlog account or create one during setup.
payload.longDescription:
连接出现错误的Slack频道和团队工作的代码仓库。Superlog会调查错误报告，在确认修复方案后自动创建修复用的拉取请求，并在原始对话线程中回复调查结果。

描述您希望自动化的流程，我们将引导您完成入门设置——从创建Superlog账户到连接工具并启用首个自动化流程。您也可以设置定期可靠性检查、Sentry问题分类和客服工作流。

连接现有Superlog账户或在设置过程中创建新账户。

payload.name: Echo UI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Echo UI is a design system for React: components that press, click and move, all made from one material, with your own style on top. This plugin brings its workflow to your agent.

• Make a style. Share a mood board and ask for a style. Echo's Design Eye reads it as a designer would and hands back the style: a foundation document and a style.json you keep and reuse.
• Pick one. Ask which style fits your product. Echo's Style Fit places the product on seven axes, ranks Echo's styles and yours against it, and makes a pick it can argue for.
• Feel it. Wearing a style gives a link that makes https://echo-ui.com wear its colours, every component pressing and moving in them.
• Build with it. In a project with a terminal, where your agent runs commands, npx echo-ui-cli init --style <name> sets the project up in that style and your agent builds from Echo's components. In a chat, the agent writes the code with them and runs Echo's check on it before handing it over.

What it sends, runs and writes

• The server. The plugin's tools are Echo's MCP server, at https://mcp.echo-ui.com/mcp. It receives what a tool is called with: a search, a component's name, a style's settings, or code to check. It needs no account and keeps none of what it's sent: code is checked and forgotten. It reads Echo's published catalog and registry from https://echo-ui.com. Cloudflare, which hosts it, keeps request logs, including the address a request came from, for up to 7 days.
• In a project with a terminal, the skills run Echo's CLI, npx echo-ui-cli, which npm downloads and which reads Echo's registry from https://echo-ui.com. init, add and style use write into the project. init also adds Echo's block to the project's agent instructions, and Echo's check as a hook in its agent settings; npx echo-ui-cli agent off removes both. Design Eye and Style Fit save styles and decisions in the builder's style library, ~/Documents/styles, on their own computer.
• In a chat, nothing is saved anywhere: styles and decisions come back as files to keep.

Privacy policy: https://echo-ui.com/privacy. Help, privacy questions and security reports: support@echo-ui.com.
payload.longDescription:
Echo UI 是一个 React 设计系统：可点击、可交互的组件，全部采用同一种材质打造，并叠加你的专属风格。
此插件将它的工作流程带到你的代理中。

• 创建一种风格。
分享一个情绪版并请求风格设计。
Echo 的 Design Eye 会像设计师一样解析它，并返回风格方案：一份基础文档和一个你可以保存并重复使用的 style.json。
• 选择一种风格。
询问哪种风格更符合你的产品。
Echo 的 Style Fit 会将产品置于七个维度中进行评估，对 Echo 的风格和你的风格进行排名，并给出一个能论证的推荐。
• 体验风格。
应用风格后会生成一个链接，可让 https://echo-ui.com 使用该风格的颜色，每个组件的交互效果都会随之变化。
• 基于风格开发。
在包含终端的项目中，你的代理运行命令时，通过 npx echo-ui-cli init --style <名称> 即可按指定风格初始化项目，你的代理将基于 Echo 的组件进行开发。
在聊天中，代理会使用这些组件编写代码，并在交付前运行 Echo 的检查。

它发送、执行和编写的內容

• 服务器。
插件工具使用的是 Echo 的 MCP 服务器，地址为 https://mcp.echo-ui.com/mcp。
它接收工具调用的内容：搜索请求、组件名称、风格设置或待检查的代码。
无需账户且不保存任何接收到的内容：代码会被检查后立即丢弃。
它从 https://echo-ui.com 读取 Echo 的公开目录和注册表。
Cloudflare（其托管方）会保留请求日志，包括请求来源地址，最长保留7天。
• 在包含终端的项目中，技能会运行 Echo 的 CLI 工具 npx echo-ui-cli，该工具由 npm 下载，并从 https://echo-ui.com 读取 Echo 的注册表。init、add 和 style 命令会向项目中写入内容。init 还会在项目代理指令中添加 Echo 的模块，并在代理设置中添加 Echo 的检查钩子；运行 npx echo-ui-cli agent off 会移除两者。
Design Eye 和 Style Fit 会将风格和决策保存在开发者本地的样式库中（~/Documents/styles）。
• 在聊天中，任何内容都不会被保存：风格和决策会以文件形式返回供保存。

隐私政策：https://echo-ui.com/privacy。
帮助、隐私问题和安全报告请联系：support@echo-ui.com。

payload.name: UiChemy AI Website Creator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
UiChemy lets you create a website with AI by chatting. Build and edit WordPress-ready sites without starting from a blank page. Describe a business or paste a client brief, and we draft a multi-page site from the UiChemy section library: sitemap, layouts, copy, colours and fonts. The result is a real project in your own UiChemy account that you keep editing on the UiChemy canvas.

What you can do:
- Build a new multi-page site from a brief, with layouts chosen from the UiChemy library and copy written to fit each slot.
- Edit an existing project: palette, fonts, buttons, cards, spacing, headings, body copy, logo, sections and pages.
- Import a site you already have (HTML, CSS and JS, or a zip) into a UiChemy project.
- Run responsive and validation checks before you hand a site over.
- Mark a finished project as exported so the UiChemy WordPress plugin can pull it into Elementor or Gutenberg.

Who it is for: freelancers, agencies and site owners who build on WordPress.

Good to know:
- You sign in with your own UiChemy account. This app only reaches projects in the account you connect, and some accounts need access to creation features before the tools work.
- We ask for your confirmation before anything that deletes a page, section, post or project, and before publishing or unpublishing a site.
- You can publish a finished project as a live site on a UiChemy address, check its status, list your sites and take one offline. It does not connect your own domain, change your hosting or log in to your WordPress site. You can also pull the project into WordPress with the UiChemy WordPress plugin.
- Use your own content and images, or content you have the right to use.
payload.longDescription:
UiChemy通过聊天方式让你用AI创建网站。
无需从空白页面开始，即可构建和编辑适合WordPress的网站。
描述一个企业或粘贴客户方案，我们将从UiChemy的模块库中拟定多页面网站：站点结构、布局、文案、配色和字体。
结果是您个人UiChemy账户中的真实项目，您可以持续在UiChemy画布中编辑。

您可以：
- 通过方案创建新多页面网站，从UiChemy库中选择布局并撰写适配各板块的文案。
- 编辑现有项目：配色方案、字体、按钮、卡片、间距、标题、正文、Logo、模块和页面。
- 将现有网站（HTML/CSS/JS或压缩包）导入UiChemy项目。
- 在交付网站前运行响应式和验证检查。
- 将完成的项目标记为导出状态，以便UiChemy WordPress插件将其导入Elementor或Gutenberg。

适用对象：在WordPress上建站的自由职业者、代理机构和网站所有者。

注意事项：
- 您需使用自己的UiChemy账户登录。
此应用仅访问您连接账户中的项目，部分账户需先获得创作功能权限才能使用工具。
- 任何删除页面、模块、文章或项目操作，以及发布/取消发布网站前，都需要您确认。
- 您可将完成的项目发布为UiChemy地址的在线网站，查看状态、列出网站并将其下线。
它不会连接您的域名、更改您的主机或登录您的WordPress网站。
您也可以通过UiChemy WordPress插件将项目导入WordPress。
- 可使用您自己的内容和图片，或您拥有使用权的内容。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Build a site from a brief, Edit colours, fonts and copy, Import an existing site, Responsive and validation checks, Mark projects exported

payload.name: agent.reviews
payload.description: 编码代理撰写的工具评价
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
agent.reviews collects reviews of developer tools that coding agents write right after real tasks: how installing, signing in, reading the docs and using a CLI, SDK, API, library or hosted service went, with a rating out of 5, what worked and what got in the way.

With this plugin you can:
- Look up how coding agents got on with a tool, such as Supabase or Stripe.
- Compare two to four tools side by side.
- Search the reviewed tools and categories by name or a few words.
- List the ten tools a category's reviews rate best, such as observability or databases.
- Publish a review of a tool you used in a real task. After a content check it shows on agent.reviews as verified, never with your name or email, and you can withdraw it at agent.reviews/account.

Reviews describe how setting a tool up and using it went for coding agents. They do not measure a tool's quality, speed or price. The plugin needs an agent.reviews account: you sign in to agent.reviews when you connect it.
payload.longDescription:
agent.reviews会收集编码代理在完成真实任务后撰写的工具评价：包括安装、登录、阅读文档以及使用CLI、SDK、API、库或托管服务的过程，给出5分制评分，说明哪些功能正常运作，哪些存在障碍。

通过此插件您可以：
- 查看编码代理使用特定工具（如Supabase或Stripe）的体验
- 并排比较两到四个工具
- 通过名称或关键词搜索已评价的工具和分类
- 查看某个分类下评分最高的十个工具（如可观测性或数据库类）
- 发布您在真实任务中使用工具的评价
- 通过内容审核后将以认证状态显示在agent.reviews，不会显示您的姓名或邮箱，您可在agent.reviews/account随时撤回评价。

评价内容描述了编码代理设置和使用工具的过程。
这些评价不涉及工具的质量、速度或价格。
该插件需要agent.reviews账户：连接时需在agent.reviews登录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Look up tool reviews, Compare tools, Search tools, List a category, Publish a review

payload.name: Domainee
payload.description: 为您的SaaS提供自定义域名
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Domainee is a custom domains API for SaaS with a native MCP server. 50 domains and 100 GB are free.

Connect a customer's hostname and get back the CNAME target, force DNS and SSL probes, debug "my domain isn't working" tickets, and manage webhook endpoints, all on the same key, rate limits, and workspace as the REST API. Hosted and stateless: nothing to deploy.

Connect your Domainee account and 11 workspace tools cover domains, webhook endpoints, and DNS verification. 16 diagnostic tools need no account at all: SSL checks, DNS and TXT record lookups, WHOIS, CNAME resolution, HTTP headers, DNS propagation, redirects, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, domain age and availability, subdomain finding, reverse IP, and website status.
payload.longDescription:
Domainee是专为SaaS设计的自定义域名API，配备原生MCP服务器。50个域名和100GB存储免费。

连接客户的主机名并获取CNAME目标，执行强制DNS和SSL探测，调试「我的域名无法使用」工单，管理Webhook端点，所有操作均使用与REST API相同的密钥、速率限制和工作区。
托管且无状态：无需部署任何内容。

连接您的Domainee账户，11个空间工具可管理域名、Webhook端点和DNS验证。16个诊断工具完全无需账户：SSL检测、DNS和TXT记录查询、WHOIS、CNAME解析、HTTP头分析、DNS传播检测、重定向检查、SPF/DKIM/DMARC验证、域名年龄与可用性检测、子域名发现、反向IP查询和网站状态检测。

Includes graph layout automation, smart-form design and runtime, dashboard charts, and process simulation. From API to KPI.
payload.longDescription: 通过Simulator.Company的REST API构建您公司的数字孪生体——包括角色、基于图的流程、表单模板、财务账户、交易及转账功能。包含图布局自动化、智能表单设计与运行时、仪表盘图表和流程仿真功能。从API到KPI。

payload.name: CubePath
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your CubePath account to check and operate your cloud infrastructure from a conversation. List your servers and their status, look at CPU, memory and bandwidth metrics, start, stop or restart servers, manage DNS zones and records, CDN zones and cache rules, private networks, floating IPs, firewalls, load balancers, NAT gateways, managed Kubernetes clusters, managed databases and object storage buckets.

You sign in with your CubePath account and choose which permissions to grant, for example read only access or write access to DNS. The plugin only sees the organization and projects your account belongs to, and every action runs with your role in that organization. Anything destructive or billable asks you first. You can revoke access at any time from Account > Connections in the CubePath dashboard.

A CubePath account is required. Billing, payments and account top ups stay in the CubePath dashboard.
payload.longDescription:
通过CubePath账户连接，即可通过对话操作云基础设施。列出服务器及其状态，查看CPU、内存和带宽指标，启动、停止或重启服务器，管理DNS区域和记录，CDN区域和缓存规则，私有网络，浮动IP，防火墙，负载均衡器，NAT网关，托管的Kubernetes集群，托管数据库和对象存储存储桶。

您需使用CubePath账户登录并选择授权权限，例如DNS的只读访问或写入权限。插件仅能看到你的账户所属的组织和项目，所有操作均以你在该组织中的角色执行。任何破坏性或计费操作都会先向你确认。你可随时在CubePath仪表板的账户>连接中撤销访问权限。

需要CubePath账户。账单、支付和账户充值仍通过CubePath仪表板处理。

payload.name: Ramus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ramus gives you a real Android device in the cloud. Attach an APK, or ask for the Ramus demo app, an APK already uploaded to Ramus, or the build from a GitHub pull request, then read the screen, tap, type, swipe, press keys, take screenshots and read device logs. The live device appears right in the chat, where you can watch and control it, inline, fullscreen or picture-in-picture, and every session has a link you can open in a browser or share with a teammate.

It is built for developers, QA and reviewers who want to see how an Android app behaves without installing an emulator.

Good to know:
- You need a Ramus account. You sign in with GitHub when you connect Ramus.
- Devices are disposable. Each session starts fresh and is discarded when it ends or after 30 minutes idle.
- Pull request previews need the Ramus GitHub App on the repository.
- adb and hot reload need the Ramus CLI (in Codex or a terminal).
- Android only. Emulators run x86_64 system images without Google Play.
payload.longDescription:
Ramus为您在云端提供真实的安卓设备。您可以附加APK文件，或请求使用Ramus演示应用（已上传至Ramus的APK文件），或GitHub拉取请求的构建版本，随后可查看屏幕、点击、输入、滑动、按键、截屏并读取设备日志。实时设备直接出现在聊天界面中，您可以以内联、全屏或画中画模式观看和控制，每个会话都会生成一个链接，可直接在浏览器中打开或与团队成员共享。

专为开发者、质量保证（QA）人员和评审人员设计，无需安装模拟器即可查看安卓应用的实际运行效果。

注意事项：
- 需要Ramus账户。连接Ramus时需通过GitHub登录。
- 设备是一次性的。每次会话从全新状态开始，结束后或30分钟无操作后将被清除。
- 拉取请求预览需要仓库中安装Ramus GitHub应用。
- 使用adb和热重载功能需要Ramus CLI（可在Codex或终端中使用）。
- 仅支持安卓系统。模拟器运行x86_64系统镜像，不包含Google Play服务。

payload.name: CliDeck Network Knowledge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CliDeck helps network engineers find commands and procedures for their equipment and software version, interpret sanitized CLI evidence, and review proposed configuration changes. Results include applicability, prerequisites, risks, verification steps, rollback guidance, and available source metadata.

Provide the vendor, model or platform, operating system, version, and relevant sanitized evidence when available. Coverage varies by vendor, platform, and version. Incomplete results remain partial or unknown; missing knowledge can create a tracked research request, and research does not guarantee an immediate answer.

CliDeck provides advisory knowledge. It does not connect to devices or execute commands. Review applicable official vendor documentation and observed device evidence before applying a change. Do not submit credentials or unredacted sensitive configurations. Snapshot analysis is performed in memory; bounded sanitized request metadata and research demands may be retained as described in the privacy policy.
payload.longDescription:
CliDeck帮助网络工程师为其设备和软件版本查找命令和操作流程，解释经过脱敏的CLI证据，并审查拟议的配置更改。结果包括适用性、先决条件、风险、验证步骤、回滚指导以及可用的源元数据。

提供厂商、型号或平台、操作系统、版本以及可用的相关脱敏证据。覆盖范围因厂商、平台和版本而异。信息不完整的请求可能仅返回部分或未知结果；缺失的知识可生成可追踪的研究请求，但研究不保证能立即获得答案。

CliDeck提供咨询类知识。它不会连接到设备或执行命令。在应用更改前，请查阅相关官方厂商文档并观察设备证据。不要提交凭证或未脱敏的敏感配置。快照分析在内存中执行；根据隐私政策，可能保留有限的脱敏请求元数据和研究需求。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find network commands and procedures by platform and software version, Interpret sanitized CLI snapshots and resolve device context, Review proposed network changes with risks and verification guidance, Read available provenance for active knowledge revisions, Track research progress for incomplete answers

payload.name: URLMe.link
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create short links on urlme.link or a branded custom domain, choose custom aliases, add a private description, and schedule expiration. Review recent links with destination, status, redirect count, last activity, device mix, and referrer mix. Update private descriptions, pause or resume redirects, permanently expire links, identify the connected workspace, and check plan usage, limits, API-key count, and custom-domain count. URLMe scopes OAuth access to the workspace you connect and enforces plan, domain, quota, and destination-safety controls. The wider URLMe platform also provides searchable workspace history, DNS and HTTPS domain setup, bulk creation, private tags and filtering, UTM parameters, destination updates, deletion, downloadable QR codes, CSV export, REST API automation with idempotent retries, per-integration API-key creation and revocation, and subscription management. Those wider features are available in the web console or REST API rather than the current chat tools.
payload.longDescription: 通过urlme.link或品牌自定义域名创建短链接，选择自定义别名，添加私有描述，并设置过期时间。查看最近的链接，包括目标地址、状态、重定向次数、最后活动时间、设备分布和来源网站分布。可更新私有描述、暂停或恢复重定向、永久过期链接、识别关联的工作区，并查看计划使用情况、配额、API密钥数量和自定义域名数量。URLMe会为连接的工作区授予OAuth访问权限，并强制实施计划、域名、配额和目标安全控制。更广泛的URLMe平台还提供可搜索的工作区历史记录、DNS和HTTPS域名设置、批量创建功能、私有标签和过滤器、UTM参数、目标地址更新、删除操作、可下载的二维码、CSV导出、支持幂等重试的REST API自动化、按集成创建和撤销API密钥，以及订阅管理。这些更广泛的功能可通过网页控制台或REST API使用，而非当前的聊天工具。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create short links, Create branded links, Use connected custom domains, Choose custom aliases, Schedule link expiration, List recent links, Review redirect analytics, Label links privately, Pause and resume links, Permanently expire links, Check plan usage, Identify the connected workspace

payload.name: FiraQuantumSafe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Check a public website's HTTPS encryption and post-quantum TLS with measured evidence. FiraQuantumSafe helps website owners, developers and security teams inspect TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3, certificate trust and expiry, security-header presence, and hybrid X25519MLKEM768 key exchange. Retrieve reports using their IDs and compare observations for the same hostname after configuration changes. Each report describes the tested public HTTPS endpoint, and unavailable measurements remain unknown. Public reports remain available for 30 days. You can optionally keep an exact report in your account on the FiraQuantumSafe website.
payload.longDescription: 通过实测证据检查公共网站的HTTPS加密和后量子TLS。FiraQuantumSafe帮助网站管理员、开发人员和安全团队检测TLS 1.2和TLS 1.3协议、证书信任状态和过期情况、安全头存在性以及混合型X25519MLKEM768密钥交换。通过报告ID检索报告，并在配置变更后对同一主机名的观测结果进行比对。每份报告会说明测试的公共HTTPS端点，未测得的数据项将保持未知状态。公开报告将在30天内保持可用，您可选择在FiraQuantumSafe网站的账户中保存特定报告。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check public website TLS and HTTPS certificates, Measure hybrid post-quantum key exchange, Inspect security-header presence, Retrieve and compare public-domain scan reports

payload.name: Video Code Reviewer
payload.description: 适用于拉取请求（PR）和代码仓库
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn pull requests and repositories into narrated video code reviews, without leaving ChatGPT.

Give it code, a diff, or context from your repository, and Video Code Reviewer turns it into a walkthrough in your language — with voiceover, highlighted code, before-and-after comparisons, diagrams and animations.

See what changed, understand why it matters, and share the explanation with your team.

How you can use Video Code Reviewer:

- Walk through a pull request (PR) before reviewing or merging
- Explain a feature or PR to a non-technical audience
- Walk through an app step by step with your own screenshots
- Explain a bug, its impact, and a proposed fix
- Onboard developers to an unfamiliar repo
- Show how your app’s architecture and data flow work
- Animate an algorithm step by step
- Compare approaches when planning a refactor
- Turn code review findings into a video your team can watch

Paste the relevant code or use a connected repository tool to provide context. Only the code excerpts shown and explained in the video are included in it. The rest of your repository is not published.

Videos are created as unlisted, with a claim link. They are not publicly listed, but anyone with the link can watch without logging in and claim the video to their Scrimba profile. To make your video private, sign in, claim it, and change its privacy setting to Private.

Want to make it your own? Keep editing on our platform, then combine your explainers into courses and playlists.

Powered by Scrimba, a learning platform with over 2 million users.
payload.longDescription:
将拉取请求和代码仓库转化为带解说的视频代码审查，无需离开ChatGPT

提供代码、代码差异或代码仓库上下文，Video Code Reviewer会将其转化为您语言的逐步讲解视频——包含语音解说、高亮代码、前后对比、图表和动画

查看更改内容，理解其重要性，并与团队分享解释

您如何使用Video Code Reviewer：

- 在审查或合并前逐步查看拉取请求（PR）
- 向非技术人员解释功能或PR
- 使用您自己的截图逐步演示应用程序
- 解释错误、其影响和解决方案
- 帮助开发者熟悉不熟悉的代码仓库
- 展示应用程序架构和数据流工作原理
- 分步演示算法
- 规划重构时对比不同方案
- 将代码审查结果转化为团队可观看的视频

粘贴相关代码或使用连接的代码仓库工具提供上下文。
视频中仅包含显示和解释的代码片段。
其余代码仓库内容不会被发布。

视频以未公开状态生成，附带认领链接。
视频不会公开显示，但持有链接的人可无需登录观看并认领至其Scrimba账号。
如需让视频私有，请登录后认领并修改隐私设置为私有

想要打造专属内容？
继续在我们的平台编辑，将你的讲解内容整合为课程和播放列表。

由拥有超过200万用户的Scrimba学习平台提供支持。

payload.name: WeWeb
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and maintain web applications in WeWeb from ChatGPT. Explore your workspaces and projects, inspect existing pages, create and update pages, and edit application workflows and data. The plugin connects to your WeWeb account and works with projects you can access. Review your changes in the WeWeb editor.
payload.longDescription: 通过ChatGPT在WeWeb中构建和维护网络应用程序。浏览您的工作区和项目，检查现有页面，创建和更新页面，并编辑应用流程和数据。该插件将连接到您的WeWeb账户，并处理您可访问的项目。在WeWeb编辑器中查看您的更改。

Specialist skills cover process creation, editing, review, and project-wide auditing. Bot skills wrap an existing process backend in a multi-platform messenger bot and keep it maintainable.

payload.name: Bird
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bird is the communications infrastructure AI agents operate. Every agent eventually has to reach a human — verify a sign-up, confirm an order, chase an invoice, answer an inbox, place a call. Connect Bird and Codex does all of it for real: email, SMS, and WhatsApp on Bird's own sending infrastructure and carrier connections, calls on Bird SIP trunks, live events to every open browser and app over Bird Realtime — with a delivery timestamp or the exact failure reason instead of a guess.

And Codex doesn't just send through Bird — it can own the endpoints. It claims its agent a durable email address in one call and answers what arrives there. It buys a phone number, gets it verified for texting, and registers the 10DLC campaign behind it. It sets up a SIP trunk and proves the caller ID with a real verification call. Addresses, numbers, trunks, and the compliance behind them — acquired in conversation.

Whatever your account can do, Codex can do here. The tools are generated from Bird's live API — the same surface Bird's own dashboard runs on — so the list Codex shows is always the current one and grows as Bird does. Some of it works before you even connect: grade any domain's live email authentication, analyze headers and DMARC reports, or search Bird's docs, no account needed.

You sign in with Bird when you connect, so there is no API key to paste and no secret sitting in your config.toml. Codex gets only the permissions you already hold, and you can revoke them from your Bird profile.

A good first ask: "Send me a test email and tell me the moment it's delivered." Building an agent? "Claim yourself an email address and reply to whatever arrives."
payload.longDescription:
Bird是AI代理运行的通信基础设施。每个代理最终都需要与人类进行交互——验证注册、确认订单、催促发票、处理邮件收件箱、拨打电话。连接Bird和Codex即可真实完成所有操作：通过Bird自有发送基础设施和运营商连接发送邮件、短信和WhatsApp，通过Bird SIP中继进行电话沟通，通过Bird实时技术向每个打开的浏览器和应用发起实时事件——提供交付时间戳或确切的失败原因，而非猜测。

Codex不仅通过Bird发送信息——它还能掌控终端。它可在一次调用中为代理申请一个持久化电子邮件地址并处理收到的内容。它会购买电话号码、完成短信验证，并在该号码后注册10DLC活动。它会设置SIP中继并通过真实验证通话证明主叫号码。地址、号码、中继以及背后的合规性——所有内容均通过对话完成获取。

您账户能完成的任何操作，Codex都能实现。工具来自Bird的实时API——与Bird自身仪表盘使用的相同界面——因此Codex展示的列表始终为最新状态，并随Bird的更新而扩展。在连接前即可使用部分功能：实时检测任意域名的邮件认证、分析邮件头和DMARC报告，或搜索Bird文档，无需账户。

连接时通过Bird登录，无需粘贴API密钥或在config.toml中保存秘密。Codex仅获取您已拥有的权限，您可随时从Bird个人资料中撤销这些权限。

一个好的初始请求：「发送测试邮件并告知送达时刻」。若在构建代理：「为自己申请一个电子邮件地址并回复收到的内容」。

payload.name: Bubble
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Bubble account to inspect and edit your apps, including pages, elements, workflows, and data types. For Bubble builders working on their apps. Available actions depend on your account permissions and the access you grant.
payload.longDescription:
将您的Bubble账户连接以检查和编辑您的应用，包括页面、元素、工作流程和数据类型。
适用于正在开发应用的Bubble开发者。

payload.name: Bland
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage your Bland voice agents from ChatGPT. Review call transcripts and outcomes, check call volume and completion rates, and inspect saved agent configurations.

Ask Bland to place or stop a call, prepare an agent change, or deploy a selected saved version. You can also validate a supplied pathway graph, score calls with existing evaluation judges, and find answers in Bland's documentation.

Requires a Bland account and access to the connected organization. Sign in through Bland to connect. Calls and evaluation runs may consume your existing Bland credits. Pathway validation requires the graph's nodes and edges. Available actions depend on your account permissions and connected tools.
payload.longDescription:
通过ChatGPT管理您的Bland语音代理。
查看通话记录和结果，检查通话量和完成率，并查看保存的代理配置。

让Bland发起或终止通话，准备代理变更，或部署已保存的版本。
您还可以验证提供的路径图，使用现有评估裁判对通话进行评分，并在Bland文档中查找答案。

需要Bland账户及对关联组织的访问权限。
通过Bland登录以建立连接。
通话和评估运行可能会消耗您的Bland信用点。
路径验证需要图的节点和边。
可用操作取决于您的账户权限和连接的工具。

payload.name: Thrixel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build World turns a one-line game idea into a 3D game you can play in the browser. It settles what you are making, generates the 3D models with Thrixel (game-ready .glb files you own), writes the three.js game around them (scene, controls, UI and touch input), and publishes it to a public thrixel.world link you can share. Everything runs on Thrixel's servers, so there is nothing to install: connect your Thrixel account once and ask for a game.
payload.longDescription: Build World可将一句话的游戏创意转化为可在浏览器中游玩的3D游戏。它将确定您正在制作的内容，通过Thrixel生成3D模型（您拥有所有权的游戏就绪.glb文件），围绕这些模型编写three.js游戏（包含场景、控制、UI和触控输入），并通过可共享的thrixel.world公开链接进行发布。所有内容均在Thrixel的服务器上运行，因此无需任何安装：只需连接您的Thrixel账户一次并请求生成游戏。

payload.name: Currents
payload.description: 修复失败的测试。验证拉取请求。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Currents gives AI agents the test results your CI records, from Playwright, Vitest, Jest and more.

Self-healing tests
• Ask why a run failed and get the errors, stack traces, screenshots and traces behind it
• Step through a run's Playwright trace, action by action, to see what the page did
• Find the root cause and fix the test, flaky ones included
• Compare a pull request's runs with main to see what the change broke

Proof of work for any change
• Before-and-after screenshots, videos, Playwright traces and DOM snapshots from CI
• A demo the agent records in a browser, saved as a run
• Evidence links posted in the pull request, so reviewers see the change working

Test suite health
• Rank your flakiest and slowest tests and spec files
• See which errors break the most tests
• Quarantine, skip or tag tests with rules, and review what they affected

Day-to-day CI work
• Reproduce a bug from a failed run and verify the fix
• Open an issue for a failure in your issue tracker
• Cancel, reset or re-check runs without leaving the chat

For teams whose CI slows them down: flaky tests that block merges, failures nobody has time to dig into, and AI-written pull requests that are hard to trust without seeing the change work. Works with GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Jira, Linear and more. You need a Currents account.
payload.longDescription:
Currents 会将你的 CI 记录的测试结果（来自 Playwright、Vitest、Jest 等）提供给 AI 代理。

自愈测试
• 查询运行失败原因并获取相关错误信息、堆栈跟踪、截图和追踪记录
• 逐步查看 Playwright 的运行追踪记录，逐个动作观察页面行为
• 定位根本原因并修复测试（包括不稳定的测试）
• 将拉取请求的运行结果与主分支对比，查看更改破坏了哪些内容

任何更改的证明
• 来自 CI 的前后截图、视频、Playwright 追踪记录和 DOM 快照
• 代理在浏览器中录制的演示，保存为一次运行
• 在拉取请求中发布证据链接，让评审人员直观看到更改效果

测试套件健康度
• 对最不稳定和最慢的测试及规格文件进行排名
• 查看哪些错误导致最多测试失败
• 通过规则对测试进行隔离、跳过或标记，并审查它们影响的内容

日常 CI 工作
• 从失败运行中复现错误并验证修复
• 在你的问题跟踪器中为失败创建工单
• 在不离开聊天界面的情况下取消、重置或重新检查运行

payload.name: Nobl9
payload.description: 服务可靠性，尽在聊天中
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nobl9 is the reliability platform, built on service level objectives (SLOs) and error budgets. It tells you whether the services your customers depend on are working, how much room you have before they notice a problem, and what to fix first. With this app, you can ask ChatGPT those questions in plain words and get answers from your own live Nobl9 data, in the same conversation where you do the rest of your work.

Ask things like: Which of my services are closest to burning their error budget this month? What reliability target should the payments API have, given how it has behaved? Which alerts fired this week and which ones mattered? Set up a target for this service, and show me before you change anything.

What you get: a straight answer on service health in one question; the story behind an alert, with the data that fired it; reliability targets built from how your services behave for users, with the error budget tracked against real monitoring data; alerts that page when a budget is burning fast and stay quiet when it drifts slowly; a status update you can paste into a channel, written from the numbers.

Nobl9 works from the monitoring tools your team already runs, including Prometheus, Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Amazon CloudWatch, Google Cloud Monitoring, Splunk and others, so there is nothing new to instrument and the answers match your dashboards.

What it can do: read your services, SLOs, error budgets, alerts and connected data sources; run a query against a connected data source; and draft, validate or apply an SLO or alert policy when you ask.

How it stays safe: you sign in with your own Nobl9 account, and ChatGPT sees only what you can see. Asking questions never changes anything. When you ask it to set up or change a target or an alert, it drafts the change, validates it against your organization, and shows you the full definition.

Requires a Nobl9 account. Documentation: docs.nobl9.com/tools-and-utilities/mcp-server
payload.longDescription:
Nobl9是基于服务级别目标（SLO）和错误预算的可靠性平台。它会告诉你客户依赖的服务是否正常运行，何时会出现问题以及优先修复哪些内容。通过此应用，您可以用自然语言向ChatGPT提问，并在工作对话中直接获取来自您自身实时Nobl9数据的答案。

您可以提问：本月哪些服务最接近耗尽其错误预算？根据支付API的运行情况，应该设置怎样的可靠性目标？本周哪些警报被触发，哪些真正重要？为该服务设置目标后，在更改任何内容前请先展示给我看。

您将获得：通过一个问题直接获取服务健康状况的明确答案；包含触发警报数据的警报背景故事；基于服务对用户实际表现设定的可靠性目标，同时跟踪真实监控数据的错误预算；在预算快速消耗时发送通知的警报，以及在预算缓慢消耗时保持静默；可直接复制到频道的状态更新，该状态更新基于实际数据生成。

Nobl9可从团队已有的监控工具中获取数据，包括Prometheus、Datadog、Dynatrace、New Relic、Amazon CloudWatch、Google Cloud Monitoring、Splunk等，无需额外部署即可使用，答案与您的仪表盘保持一致。

它可实现的功能：读取您的服务、SLO、错误预算、警报和连接的数据源；对连接的数据源执行查询；当您提出要求时，可起草、验证或应用SLO或警报策略。

安全性保障：您使用自己的Nobl9账户登录，ChatGPT仅能查看您可见的内容。提问永远不会修改任何内容。当您要求设置或更改目标或警报时，它会先起草更改内容，根据您的组织配置进行验证，并向您展示完整定义。

需要Nobl9账户。文档：docs.nobl9.com/tools-and-utilities/mcp-server

Local Codex and connected build hosts can create, run and test apps. ChatGPT without a build host can explain, generate code and read public docs, but cannot run or deploy projects. Hosting requires an available deployment provider and authorized account.
payload.longDescription: 发现适合的TanStack库，构建新应用，为现有项目添加功能，调试问题并规划迁移。包含当前官方目录中每个库的简介，以及公开的文档工具。使用TanStack Intent获取与已安装包版本匹配的更深入指导。本地Codex和连接的构建主机可以创建、运行和测试应用。没有构建主机的ChatGPT可以解释、生成代码和阅读公开文档，但无法运行或部署项目。托管需要可用的部署提供商和授权账户。

payload.name: AppTail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AppTail helps iOS developers decide what to build, where to launch, and how to improve App Store visibility. Research niches across storefronts, compare competing apps and their ratings, explore keyword popularity and search results, and turn listing and review evidence into practical ASO recommendations. Works for pre-launch ideas as well as existing apps. Connect your AppTail account with OAuth. Data access and tracking limits depend on your plan. Public app data and competitor estimates are distinct from measured App Store Connect analytics for your connected apps. Competitor downloads and revenue, when available, are rolling 30-day estimates. AppTail does not expose a standalone numeric keyword difficulty score, cover Google Play research, or publish listing metadata. Recommendations are based on available data and do not guarantee rankings or downloads.
payload.longDescription: AppTail帮助iOS开发者决定开发什么、在何处发布以及如何提升App Store的可见性。通过研究各个商店的细分市场、比较竞争应用及其评分、探索关键词热度和搜索结果，并将应用列表和评价证据转化为实用的ASO建议。该工具既适用于发布前的创意，也适用于现有应用。通过OAuth连接您的AppTail账户。数据访问和跟踪限制取决于您的计划。公开应用数据和竞争对手估算与您连接应用的App Store Connect分析数据不同。竞争对手的下载量和收入（如可用）为滚动30天的估算数据。AppTail不提供独立的数字关键词难度评分，不涵盖Google Play研究，也不发布列表元数据。推荐基于可用数据，不保证排名或下载量。

payload.name: nunu.ai

Author test cases in natural language and run them end to end on real Android and iOS devices, Windows VMs, and Browsers. Automatically inspect past runs, review bugs, and update test cases. Create complete test plans and run them on every new build or on a schedule.
payload.longDescription: 使用 nunu.ai 插件自动化 QA 测试。用自然语言编写测试用例，并在真实 Android 和 iOS 设备、Windows 虚拟机及浏览器上端到端运行。自动检查过去的运行记录、查看缺陷并更新测试用例。创建完整的测试计划，并在每次新版本构建时或按计划定期运行。

payload.name: Relvato
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Relvato monitors websites in a real browser: sign-ups, logins, checkout, payments, page speed, search visibility and security. It runs its monitors on a schedule and again every time the site changes, and it works on any website, going deepest on WordPress and WooCommerce.

This plugin brings your Relvato account into ChatGPT. Sign in once, then ask in plain words:
- "Which of my sites needs attention right now?"
- "Why did checkout fail last night, and how do I fix it?"
- "How fast is my shop for real visitors, and what slows it down?"
- "Add my product pages to the visual monitor and run it."

What ChatGPT can do with it:
- Set up: add a site, walk you through proving it's yours (the WordPress plugin or a DNS record), and pick monitors for your goals.
- Configure: schedules, re-runs after WordPress updates, the pages the visual monitor compares, checkout details, and custom monitors Relvato's AI writes from a plain-language goal.
- Read: health and uptime, real-visitor and lab Core Web Vitals, each run's findings with screenshots, WordPress updates and the activity log.
- Act: run monitors now, get the brief for fixing a failure, and on WordPress apply the one fix a run proposes or update a vulnerable plugin, with automatic undo if anything breaks.
- Review: when you confirm a change is intended, accept a new screenshot or page structure, or ignore a finding. Every such decision can be undone.

You stay in control. Tools that change your site are marked so ChatGPT asks you first. ChatGPT works within your Relvato account's limits, can't skip proving a site is yours, and can't approve file-integrity, script or DNS changes, change who receives your alerts, see secrets, delete data or touch billing. Those stay in the Relvato dashboard.

Sign-in uses your Relvato account, and you can disconnect ChatGPT at any time under MCP connector → Connected assistants.
payload.longDescription:
Relvato通过真实浏览器监控网站：注册、登录、结账、支付、页面速度、搜索可见性和安全性。
它会按计划运行监控，并在网站每次变更时重新运行，适用于任何网站，尤其深度支持WordPress和WooCommerce。

此插件将您的Relvato账户接入ChatGPT。
只需登录一次，然后用简单语言提问：
- "哪些网站现在需要关注？"
- "昨晚结账为何失败，该如何修复？"
- "真实访客访问您的店铺有多快，哪些因素导致变慢？"
- "将产品页面添加到视觉监控并运行。"

ChatGPT可借此实现的功能：
- 设置：添加网站，引导您证明所有权（通过WordPress插件或DNS记录），并根据您的目标选择监控项。
- 配置：设置时间表、WordPress更新后的重跑、视觉监控对比的页面、结账详情，以及Relvato AI根据自然语言目标生成的自定义监控。
- 读取：健康状态与可用性、真实访客和实验室核心性能指标、每次运行的检测结果（含截图）、WordPress更新和操作日志。
- 执行：立即运行监控，获取故障修复简报，在WordPress上应用运行提出的单一修复方案或更新存在漏洞的插件，若出现异常会自动回滚。
- 审核：确认更改是故意操作后，接受新截图或页面结构，或忽略检测结果。
每次决策都可以撤销。

您始终掌握控制权。
会更改您网站的工具会特别标记，ChatGPT会先询问您。
ChatGPT在您的Relvato账户限制内运行，无法跳过网站所有权验证，也无法批准文件完整性、脚本或DNS更改，无法修改警报接收人、查看敏感信息、删除数据或操作计费。
这些功能仍保留在Relvato仪表盘中。

登录使用您的Relvato账户，您可以在MCP连接器→已连接的助手下随时断开ChatGPT。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Add a website and set up its monitors, Read site health, uptime, performance and run results, Run monitors now and follow the results, Get the brief for fixing a failed run, Configure schedules, visual pages and checkout details, Write custom monitors from a plain-language goal, Apply the fix a run proposes, with undo (WordPress), Accept an intended visual change, with undo

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VoiceLab is an AI voice platform for text-to-speech, speech-to-text, dubbing, meeting notetaking, and voice agents. Turn text into natural speech, transcribe and summarize meetings, localize audio with dubbing, and connect voice tools to agents via MCP.

payload.name: Ronda
payload.description: 通过聊天编辑你的网页应用
payload.summaryOriginal: Edit your web app from chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Edit existing web apps from ChatGPT. Connect a GitHub repository and ronda starts an isolated copy of the app with a running dev server and a live preview link. ChatGPT reads the code, makes small changes, checks the build output and shows you the result in the preview. Changes ChatGPT makes directly stay in the sandbox until you ask for a pull request. Changes made by ronda's hosted agent are pushed to a working branch in your repository (its name starts with ronda/session-), never to your default branch. Use it to change page copy, fix layout bugs, adjust styles or update components without setting up a local environment. ronda works with repositories you connect through your own GitHub account and only acts on projects in your ronda workspace. Limitations: the app must be able to run as a web project in a single container, setup can take a minute or two, and scripts run in the sandbox have time and output limits.
payload.longDescription:
从ChatGPT中编辑现有的网页应用。
连接GitHub仓库后，ronda会启动应用的隔离副本，包含运行中的开发服务器和实时预览链接。
ChatGPT会阅读代码，进行小规模修改，检查构建输出，并在预览中展示结果。
ChatGPT做出的修改会保留在沙盒中，直到你请求拉取请求。
由ronda托管代理进行的修改会推送到你仓库中的工作分支（分支名称以ronda/session-开头），永远不会推送至你的默认分支。
你可以用它来修改页面文案、修复布局错误、调整样式或更新组件，而无需设置本地环境。ronda通过你个人GitHub账户连接的仓库工作，仅对ronda工作区内的项目进行操作。
限制条件：应用必须能够在单个容器中作为网页项目运行，初始化可能需要一到两分钟，沙盒中运行的脚本存在时间和输出限制。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: List connected GitHub repositories, Read and search code in a sandbox, Edit code on a separate branch, Run the project's build, lint and test scripts and add npm packages in a sandbox, Open a pull request on request

payload.name: RealMarket Site Check
payload.description: 检查网站邮箱和安全性
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RealMarket Site Check helps developers and website maintainers diagnose public website configuration and prioritize technical fixes. Give it a website address to receive findings from public DNS records, pages and scripts.

- Email and site security: check SPF, DKIM and DMARC records, mail servers, HTTPS and security headers.
- Web app security: inspect public JavaScript for exposed API keys and public source maps, and check security headers, deployment freshness and error monitoring.
- Shopify storefront diagnostics: check social login, wishlist, the share of sold-out products and storefronts in several countries. This check requires a Shopify store.

Each report includes a verdict, findings and suggested next steps. Email reports are in Portuguese; web app and storefront reports support Portuguese and Spanish. No account is needed. Checks only read public information: they never log in, submit forms or access private areas. A firewall can block a check, and the results are not a comprehensive security audit.
payload.longDescription:
RealMarket Site Check 帮助开发者和网站维护者诊断公共网站配置并优先处理技术修复。输入网站地址即可获取公共DNS记录、页面和脚本的检测结果。

- 邮箱与网站安全：检查SPF、DKIM和DMARC记录、邮件服务器、HTTPS及安全头
- Web应用安全：检测公共JavaScript中的暴露API密钥和公开源映射，检查安全头、部署新鲜度及错误监控
- Shopify店铺诊断：检查社交登录、心愿单、售罄产品占比及多个国家的店铺情况
此检测需要具备Shopify店铺

每份报告包含结论、检测结果和建议下一步操作。
邮件报告为葡萄牙语；Web应用和店铺报告支持葡萄牙语和西班牙语。
无需账户即可使用。
检测仅读取公开信息：不会登录、提交表单或访问私有区域。
防火墙可能阻止检测，且结果不构成全面安全审计。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check SPF, DKIM and DMARC records of a domain, Check HTTPS and security headers of a website, Inspect public web app scripts for exposed keys and source maps, Diagnose social login, wishlist and sold-out products in a Shopify store, Reports in Portuguese or Spanish

payload.name: BaselineLab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HTML and CSS playground with thirteen labs: Grid, Flexbox, Columns, Grid Lanes, border, border-radius, color-mix, box-shadow, datalist, details, Popover, text-box and text-wrap. Search by name or purpose, filter by category, adjust native controls, inspect reusable code and continue with the same settings on BaselineLab. Local changes are shared with the model only when requested. Experimental features show current-environment support notices; rendering does not establish support in other browsers.
payload.longDescription:
包含13个实验模块的HTML和CSS游乐场：网格布局、弹性盒子布局、列布局、网格轨道、边框、圆角边框、颜色混合、盒子阴影、数据列表、详情面板、弹出框、文本框和文本换行。
通过名称或用途搜索，按类别筛选，调整原生控件，检查可重用代码，并在BaselineLab上继续使用相同设置。
本地更改仅在请求时与模型共享。
实验性功能会显示当前环境支持提示；渲染结果不表示其他浏览器的支持状态。

payload.name: Hopper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hopper serves open-source models for real-time voice agents: a low-latency LLM behind a standard chat-completions API, plus text-to-speech and speech-to-text. Hopper speaks text with an inline audio player, transcribes recordings you attach (WAV, MP3, M4A, Ogg, FLAC or WebM) with word timestamps, lists models and prices, returns tested integration code for popular voice-agent frameworks, and reviews a voice agent's prompt, tools and client code for what delays its first reply. After you sign in with your Hopper account, it shows your usage and creates API keys. Where it can run commands in your project, the plugin also sets Hopper up in a voice-agent codebase: it measures time to first token on the agent's own system prompt and tools in a 10-turn simulated call and shows the results before changing any code, and after you say go it switches only the LLM. Text and audio you send go to Hopper's API; see withhopper.com/privacy.
payload.longDescription:
Hopper为实时语音代理提供开源模型：基于标准聊天完成API的低延迟大语言模型，以及文本转语音和语音转文本功能。
Hopper通过内联音频播放器将文本转化为语音，可为您上传的录音（WAV、MP3、M4A、Ogg、FLAC或WebM格式）添加单词时间戳，展示模型及价格列表，提供主流语音代理框架的经过测试的集成代码，并审查语音代理的提示词、工具和客户端代码，分析其首次回复延迟原因。
登录Hopper账户后，可查看使用情况并创建API密钥。
当插件可在您的项目中执行命令时，它还会在语音代理代码库中配置Hopper：在10轮模拟通话中测量代理自身系统提示和工具的首次标记时间，并在修改任何代码前展示结果；当您输入go后，仅替换大语言模型部分。
您发送的文本和音频将通过Hopper的API处理，请访问withhopper.com/privacy了解详情。

payload.name: camelRun
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
camelRun is camelAI's hosted runtime for AI agents. Connect your camelRun account to create agents from a plain-language description, give them built-in tools such as web search, run them and read their replies, and deploy agent.yaml manifests that keep an agent's configuration as a reusable, versioned definition. Agents are durable: each keeps its history until you delete it, can wake itself on a schedule, and can stop to ask you a question or for an approval, which you answer from the conversation.

It is for developers and teams who build agents for their products or their own work and want to try, adjust and manage them without leaving the conversation.

The plugin acts only on the camelRun account you sign in with, and only on its agents, definitions and schedules. Runs use your account's credit. It does not manage billing, API tokens or provider keys; do those in the camelRun console. Tool servers that need secrets are best deployed with the camelrun CLI, which reads them from its environment, so credentials never pass through the conversation. Deleting an agent or definition cannot be undone, so you are asked to confirm first.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create and configure agents, Deploy agent manifests, Run agents and read their replies, Answer agents' questions and approvals, Schedule agent wake-ups, Delete agents and definitions

payload.name: HelpTester
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HelpTester brings its browser-based hardware tests and developer tools into ChatGPT.

Interactive hardware tests that run directly in the chat:
- Keyboard Tester: on-screen keyboard that lights up every key you press, finds dead, stuck or ghosting keys
- Mouse Polling Rate Tester: measures your mouse's polling rate in Hz
- Gamepad / Controller Tester: buttons, triggers, sticks and vibration (experimental inside ChatGPT)
- Microphone Tester: live level meter, device selection, test recording (asks for microphone permission)
- MIDI Device Tester: shows incoming notes from MIDI keyboards and controllers (Chrome/Edge)
- Touchscreen Tester: draw, precision, multitouch, gesture and latency tests
- Speaker Tester: left/right channel, frequency sweep and test tones

Network checks:
- IP Address & Network Check: your public IP, country, city, ISP plus latency and connectivity tests
- Internet Speed Test: download, upload, ping and jitter

Developer tools:
- JSON Formatter & Validator
- Base64 Encoder / Decoder
- QR Code Generator (text, URL, email, phone, Wi-Fi, vCard)
- DNS Checker (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA)
- AI Unicode Remover (strips invisible characters from AI-generated text)

Tests that need the full browser (webcam, dead pixel, CPU/GPU stress test, favicon checker/generator, tag checker, song key finder) open on helptester.com.

All tests use standard browser APIs and run client-side. No AI is used for the tests themselves, nothing is recorded or uploaded unless you explicitly save a result.
payload.longDescription:
HelpTester将基于浏览器的硬件测试和开发者工具引入ChatGPT。

可在聊天中直接运行的交互式硬件测试：
- 键盘测试器：按下每个键时会亮起的屏幕键盘，可检测损坏、卡键或鬼影键
- 鼠标轮询率测试器：测量鼠标的轮询率（Hz）
- 游戏手柄/控制器测试器：测试按钮、扳机键、摇杆和震动（在ChatGPT内为实验性功能）
- 麦克风测试器：实时电平表、设备选择、测试录音（需要麦克风权限）
- MIDI设备测试器：显示来自MIDI键盘和控制器的输入音符（仅限Chrome/Edge）
- 触摸屏测试器：绘制测试、精度、多点触控、手势和延迟测试
- 音响测试器：左右声道测试、频率扫描和测试音 tone

网络检测：
- IP地址与网络检测：您的公网IP、国家、城市、运营商，以及延迟和连接性测试
- 网速测试：下载速度、上传速度、ping值和抖动

开发者工具：
- JSON格式化工具与验证器
- Base64编码/解码器
- 二维码生成器（支持文本、网址、邮件、电话、Wi-Fi、vCard）
- DNS检测器（A、AAAA、MX、TXT、NS、CNAME、SOA记录）
- AI Unicode清理器（移除AI生成文本中的不可见字符）

需要完整浏览器的功能（摄像头、坏点检测、CPU/GPU压力测试、favicon检测/生成器、标签检测器、歌曲调性检测器）请访问helptester.com使用。

所有测试均使用标准浏览器API并在客户端运行。
测试本身不使用任何AI技术，除非您主动保存结果，否则不会记录或上传任何数据。

payload.name: Cheapest Domains
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Focus on the real cost of keeping a domain: its annual renewal price. Compare selected registrars, with initial registration prices shown separately and supported multi-year estimates. Your assistant suggests names and checks availability and premium status. Preserve source dates, partial coverage and unknown results. Renewal rates can change; purchases and exact premium prices remain at the registrar. Optional Cloudflare Radar data measures DNS popularity, not Google search competition. The native form collects seed names and an optional project brief; your current assistant generates and checks suggestions. The website form prepares a request to copy into a connected assistant. Website subscription authentication is not implemented.
payload.longDescription:
专注于保留域名的实际成本：其年度续费价格。
比较选定的注册商，初始注册价格单独显示并支持多年期估算。

mailX finds out why your emails land in spam or junk, using live DNS checks, and tells you exactly what to fix.

Ask in plain English, for example "why are my emails going to spam?", "does my domain have the SPF, DKIM and DMARC that Gmail and Yahoo require for bulk senders?" or "check DMARC for acme.com". mailX runs the checks in real time:

- Full email deliverability audit in one step: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, blacklists and MX, with the fixes to apply in priority order
- SPF, DKIM, DMARC and BIMI validation, with the exact record found and what it means
- DKIM selector detection, so you don't need to know your selector
- Blacklist lookup for a domain across major DNS blocklists such as Spamhaus, Barracuda and SpamCop
- MX, TXT, CNAME, PTR and full DNS lookups
- SPF and DMARC record generation for Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and other providers, ready to paste into your DNS provider
- SMTP and IMAP server settings for Gmail, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Zoho and other providers

Useful when you set up a new domain, move to Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, launch a newsletter or an outreach campaign, or see emails going to spam in Gmail or Outlook.

Every result comes from a live DNS query, so you see the state of your domain right now. No account or setup needed.

mailX only reads public DNS data. It never changes your DNS, never sends email and never asks for passwords.

Built by Mailwarm Inc. (YC S20), an email deliverability company.
payload.longDescription:
mailX通过实时DNS检查找出您的邮件进入垃圾邮件或垃圾箱的原因，并明确告知您需要修复的具体问题。

- DKIM选择器检测功能，无需您知晓选择器名称
- 跨主要DNS黑名单（如Spamhaus、Barracuda和SpamCop）的域名黑名单查询
- MX、TXT、CNAME、PTR及完整DNS查询
- 为Google Workspace、Microsoft 365等服务商生成SPF和DMARC记录，可直接复制到您的DNS服务商
- Gmail、Outlook、Microsoft 365、Zoho等服务商的SMTP和IMAP服务器设置

适用于设置新域名、迁移到Google Workspace或Microsoft 365、启动新闻通讯或推广活动，或发现Gmail/Outlook邮件进入垃圾箱时的场景。

所有结果均来自实时DNS查询，您可立即查看域名当前状态。
无需账户或配置。

mailX仅读取公共DNS数据。
从不修改您的DNS设置，不发送邮件，也不要求提供密码。

由邮件投递优化公司Mailwarm Inc.（YC S20）开发。

payload.name: Glossa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Glossa lets ChatGPT work on a project on your computer. Start Glossa in a project folder and ChatGPT can search and read your code, look at images, make careful edits, and, if you allow it, run your tests, builds, Git, and other commands with the tools you already have installed.

You pick the access for each folder when you start it:
- Read-only: ChatGPT can list, search, and read files and view PNG, JPEG, and WebP images.
- Workspace (the default): ChatGPT can also create, edit, move, and delete files inside that folder. Edits check the file's current version first, so your own changes aren't silently overwritten.
- System: ChatGPT can also run commands. Commands run as your computer account, with its environment, credentials, files, and network access. They aren't sandboxed or limited to the project folder, so turn this on only for an account and machine you're comfortable giving that access.

How it works: the Glossa CLI on your computer connects out to the Glossa relay, so nothing on your machine accepts incoming connections. The relay passes requests to your computer and doesn't store your file contents, command arguments, or command output. Glossa blocks recognizable passwords, API keys, and tokens in file text, edits, and command output before they leave your computer. Images are passed through as they are.

Glossa doesn't add another AI model or agent. ChatGPT does the work, and your plan's usage limits and available features still apply. Don't use Glossa with payment card data, health records, government ID numbers, or account credentials.

To get started, install the CLI with npm install -g @ariobarin/glossa, run glossa in your project folder, and pair your computer when it asks.

payload.name: ATL Sandbox
payload.description: 在云端沙盒中运行代码
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ATL Sandbox gives ChatGPT isolated cloud computers for your account. Ask in plain language and ChatGPT creates a sandbox, runs Python, Node.js, C/C++, Rust, or shell commands, and returns the results to the conversation.

What you can do:
- Run code in ready-made environments (Python, Node.js, GCC, Rust, Blender) or, with the developer profile, any public Linux container image.
- Attach NVIDIA GPUs for CUDA, model inference, and Blender Cycles rendering.
- Keep work in encrypted persistent workspaces and private object storage, and use a PostgreSQL database that belongs to your account.
- Publish static websites and expose web apps on public links when you choose to share them.
- Schedule recurring jobs and one-off runs, and check their history later.

Who it is for: developers, analysts, students, and creators who want their assistant to run real code and keep the results.

Security: every sandbox runs behind its own user-space kernel and can reach only the compute, storage, and database of the signed-in account. Infrastructure credentials never enter the conversation. Actions that change or delete data are marked so ChatGPT asks before running them.

Limitations: an ATL Sandbox account is required. Accounts have usage limits on concurrent sandboxes, run time, storage, GPUs, and schedules, and running compute stops when an account reaches its limit. Instant sandboxes discard their files when stopped. Images must be linux/amd64 and include /bin/sh. Interactive terminals and Codex sessions are not available in this app. Do not paste passwords, API keys, or payment details into sandboxes.
payload.longDescription:
ATL Sandbox为你的账户提供隔离的云电脑供ChatGPT使用。用自然语言提问，ChatGPT将创建沙盒，运行Python、Node.js、C/C++、Rust或shell命令，并将结果返回对话中。

可实现的功能：
- 在预设环境（Python、Node.js、GCC、Rust、Blender）中运行代码，或通过开发者资料使用任何公共Linux容器镜像。
- 附加NVIDIA GPU用于CUDA计算、模型推理和Blender Cycles渲染。

适用人群：希望助手能运行真实代码并保存结果的开发者、分析师、学生和创作者。

账户对同时运行的沙盒数量、运行时长、存储空间、GPU资源和任务计划设有使用上限，达到限制后计算资源将停止运行。

See what changed, switch between before and after, walk through the affected path, and tap any block for its source file and exact lines. Optional plain-language narration explains the observed behavior without hiding the evidence.

No account or API key is needed. The hosted tools process only the selected source or analysis provided to them, in memory, without storing it. The standalone editor analyzes code locally in your browser.
payload.longDescription:
Turnpoint让代码变更更易理解。无需在脑海中逐行拼凑冗长的代码差异，通过交互式手写地图即可清晰查看涉及的函数、类和数据结构。

支持JavaScript、TypeScript、JSX和TSX格式。静态分析仅追踪所提供文件中的代码关系，不执行代码、不验证运行时行为、不自动补全缺失依赖。插件在对话中添加可视化解释，同时保留原生代码差异查看功能。

What it can do:
- Show who you are connected as and which accounts you can use.
- List your projects, open one, and read account analytics.
- List a project's builds, open a build, and list the visual changes it found, with links to the baseline, new and diff images.
- Approve or reject a build with a review, list reviews, and dismiss one.
- Mark an individual change as ignored, or un-ignore it.
- Read and post comments on a build, edit or delete your own, add and remove reactions, and resolve, unresolve, subscribe to or unsubscribe from a comment thread.
- Create a project.

Tools: 24 named tools (getMe, listProjects, getProject, getAccountAnalytics, listBuilds, getBuild, listBuildDiffs, listReviews, listBuildComments, getBuildComment, createReview, dismissReview, ignoreChange, unignoreChange, createProject, createBuildComment, updateBuildComment, deleteBuildComment, addBuildCommentReaction, removeBuildCommentReaction, resolveBuildCommentThread, unresolveBuildCommentThread, subscribeBuildCommentThread, unsubscribeBuildCommentThread).

Who it is for: teams that run visual tests with SnapVisor and want to check and review builds from a conversation.

How it connects: you sign in to SnapVisor with OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) and choose on the consent screen which account the connection covers and which permissions it gets. Connected applications are listed in your SnapVisor settings, where you can revoke them.

Limitations: SnapVisor does not generate images. It only compares and serves the screenshots your own CI uploaded, as short-lived signed links. The plugin cannot run your tests or upload screenshots, and it does not change billing.
payload.longDescription:
SnapVisor是一个视觉回归测试平台。您的持续集成系统将截图作为构建版本上传，SnapVisor会逐像素对比基准图像，您的团队可以查看并批准发现的更改。SnapVisor插件可让ChatGPT与您共同完成审核流程。

主要功能：
- 显示当前连接身份及可用账户
- 列出项目，打开项目后查看账户分析数据
- 列出项目的构建版本，打开后查看发现的视觉变化，包含基准图、新截图和差异对比图的链接
- 对构建版本进行审核批准或驳回，列出审核记录并取消审核
- 标记单个变更项为忽略状态，或取消忽略标记
- 查看和发布构建评论，编辑或删除自有评论，添加或移除表情反应，并解决、取消解决、订阅或退订评论线程
- 创建新项目

工具列表：24个命名工具（getMe，listProjects，getProject，getAccountAnalytics，listBuilds，getBuild，listBuildDiffs，listReviews，listBuildComments，getBuildComment，createReview，dismissReview，ignoreChange，unignoreChange，createProject，createBuildComment，updateBuildComment，deleteBuildComment，addBuildCommentReaction，removeBuildCommentReaction，resolveBuildCommentThread，unresolveBuildCommentThread，subscribeBuildCommentThread，unsubscribeBuildCommentThread）

适用对象：使用SnapVisor进行视觉测试并希望在对话中查看和审核构建的团队

连接方式：您可通过OAuth 2.1（PKCE）协议登录SnapVisor，并在授权页面选择连接覆盖的账户及所需权限。已连接的应用程序会在您的SnapVisor设置中列出，可随时撤销权限

使用限制：SnapVisor不会生成图像。它仅对比并提供您自身持续集成系统上传的截图，且仅通过短期有效的签名链接提供访问。插件无法运行测试或上传截图，也不影响计费信息

payload.name: is it DNS?
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Is it DNS? Ask from a vantage that is not your network. Six read-only tools: check_domain reads a site or domain that is not loading; dig asks one public resolver for one record; trace walks the delegation from the root and shows where it stops; sweep_domain asks a zone's own name servers whether they agree; dnssec_chain reads the DNSSEC chain from the root; registration reads the registry's RDAP record for holds and expiry. Each answer states what was asked, of which server, from where and when, and ends with an api: link to the same reading. No account, no key.
payload.longDescription:
这是DNS问题吗？
从非您网络的视角进行查询。
六个只读工具：check_domain可检测无法加载的网站或域名；dig向一个公共解析器查询一条记录；trace从根节点开始追踪委托路径并显示中断位置；sweep_domain向域名所在服务器查询是否一致；dnssec_chain从根节点读取DNSSEC链；registration读取注册商的RDAP记录查看域名限制和到期信息。
每个结果会标明查询内容、目标服务器、来源位置和时间，并附带指向相同数据源的API链接。
无需账户，无需密钥。

payload.name: Statewright AI
payload.description: 在聊天中使用您的工作流
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Statewright workflows in chat. Connect your Statewright account through OAuth to list available workflows, inspect workflow definitions, and check workflow state. Statewright supports state-machine workflows for AI-assisted development. Available tools and enforcement depend on the connected host. This plugin cannot change the selected model of a ChatGPT web conversation.
payload.longDescription:
在聊天中使用 Statewright 工作流。
通过 OAuth 连接您的 Statewright 账户，即可查看可用的工作流、检查工作流定义并查看工作流状态。
Statewright 支持用于 AI 辅助开发的状态机工作流。
可用工具和执行功能取决于连接的主机平台。
此插件无法更改 ChatGPT 网页对话中选择的模型。

payload.name: Vibe Coding Library
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vibe Coding Library searches 241 public engineering workflows and loads the selected recipe with its domain skill, working contract and required references. Search and catalog metadata support English, Spanish, Russian and Simplified Chinese; technical instructions are in English. Workflows cover repository mapping, planning, code review, API contracts, data, infrastructure, AI and release checks. One bundled skill guides workflow selection. The read-only MCP tools require no account or API key. Your agent applies retrieved guidance using its project tools and permissions.
payload.longDescription: Vibe Coding Library 搜索 241 个公共工程工作流，并加载选定配方及其领域技能、工作合同和所需参考文献。搜索和目录元数据支持英语、西班牙语、俄语和简体中文；技术说明为英文。工作流涵盖仓库映射、规划、代码审查、API 合同、数据、基础设施、AI 及发布检查。一个内置技能可指导工作流选择。只读 MCP 工具无需账户或 API 密钥。您的代理将通过项目工具和权限应用检索到的指导。

payload.name: AI2SQL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AI2SQL turns plain-English requests into correct SQL for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle, Snowflake and BigQuery, and helps with the SQL you already have: fix a failing statement, optimize a slow one, explain an inherited query, or convert between dialects.

Connect your databases at ai2sql.io and ChatGPT can read their schema and run read-only queries against them. Writes and DDL are blocked, so nothing in your database can be changed from a chat.

Sign in with your existing AI2SQL account to use it in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
AI2SQL可将自然英语请求转换为PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQL Server、SQLite、Oracle、Snowflake和BigQuery的正确SQL，并帮助处理您已有的SQL：修复失败的语句、优化缓慢的查询、解释继承的查询或在不同方言间进行转换。

在ai2sql.io连接您的数据库，ChatGPT可以读取其模式并对其运行只读查询。写入操作和DDL（数据定义语言）已被禁用，因此无法通过聊天操作修改数据库内容。

使用现有的AI2SQL账户登录以在ChatGPT中使用该工具。

payload.name: API Status Check
payload.description: 当前服务是否出现故障？
payload.summaryOriginal: Is a service down right now?
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
API Status Check tells you whether an online service is down right now. Ask about ChatGPT, GitHub, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Discord, Slack, Zoom, Stripe, Shopify, Cloudflare, Steam, Fortnite or about 270 other apps and APIs, by name or by domain. It reads the service's official status page at the moment you ask and reports the overall state, which components are affected, any active incidents and when they started, with a link to the official status page.

Ask about the past too: it lists the incidents a service has published over the last days or weeks, with impact and how long each lasted, so you can see whether a problem is new or recurring.

Useful when something stops working and you want to know whether it is you or them: a developer seeing errors from a third-party API, a team whose tools are failing, or anyone whose app will not load.

Limitations: it covers a fixed list of about 285 services and says so when a name is not on it. A status page shows what the vendor has acknowledged; problems limited to one region, network or account may not appear there. For services that publish no status feed it can only check whether the service's API responds, and it says when that is what it did.
payload.longDescription:
API状态检查可告知您某个在线服务当前是否出现故障。您可以根据名称或域名查询ChatGPT、GitHub、AWS、Google Cloud、Azure、Discord、Slack、Zoom、Stripe、Shopify、Cloudflare、Steam、Fortnite或另外270多个应用和API的状态。该工具会在您查询时读取服务的官方状态页面，并报告整体状态、受影响组件、任何活跃事件及其开始时间，并附上官方状态页面链接。

您也可以查询历史状态：它会列出服务最近几天或几周内发布的所有事件，包括影响范围和持续时间，从而判断问题是否为新出现或重复发生。

当某些功能停止工作时非常有用：您可以判断问题是出在自身还是服务方。例如开发者遇到第三方API错误、团队工具全部失效，或任何应用无法加载的情况。

限制条件：仅覆盖约285项固定服务，若名称不在列表中会明确提示。状态页面仅显示供应商已承认的问题；仅限单一区域、网络或账户的问题可能不会显示。对于未发布状态源的服务，仅能检查其API是否响应，并会在结果中说明。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check if a service is down, List a service's recent incidents

payload.name: Mjegulla
payload.description: 阿尔巴尼亚语网站构建工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Build a website in Albanian just by describing it. Mjegulla is a website builder for Albanian speakers: tell ChatGPT about your business — in Albanian or any language — and Mjegulla creates the pages, copy and images in your Mjegulla account and gives you a public address to share. Ask for changes in plain language and Mjegulla updates the site; publish the latest version when you are ready.

What you can do:
• Create a new website from a description
• Edit an existing website with plain-language instructions
• Check when a build has finished and what changed
• See your websites as cards with a live preview, status and address
• Publish the latest version

Mjegulla only works with websites in the account you sign in with. It uses the AI credits included in your account. It cannot delete websites, change your plan or see payment details.
payload.longDescription:
只需描述即可创建阿尔巴尼亚语网站
Mjegulla是面向阿尔巴尼亚语用户的网站构建工具：向ChatGPT描述您的业务（可用阿尔巴尼亚语或任何其他语言），Mjegulla会在您的Mjegulla账户中创建页面、内容和图片，并为您提供可分享的公开地址。用自然语言提出修改要求，Mjegulla会更新网站；准备好后即可发布最新版本。

您可以执行以下操作：
• 通过描述创建新网站
• 用自然语言指令编辑现有网站
• 查看构建完成状态及变更内容
• 以卡片形式查看网站，包含实时预览、状态和地址
• 发布最新版本

Mjegulla仅适用于您登录账户中的网站。
它使用账户内包含的AI积分。
无法删除网站、更改您的套餐或查看支付详情。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create websites, Edit websites, Publish websites, Check build status

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search the Uniquel UI library for components and blocks, then retrieve the source for the item you select. A Uniquel account is required; All Access members can retrieve premium blocks.
payload.longDescription: 在Uniquel UI库中搜索组件和区块，然后获取你所选项目的源代码。需要Uniquel账户；全访问会员可获取高级区块。

payload.name: Website Launch Check
payload.description: 在网站上线前进行检查
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Website Launch Check scans a public website and reports observable launch-readiness signals across technical SEO, social preview metadata, selected HTTP security headers, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and basic technical setup. It is read-only and does not log in or modify the target website. Results are diagnostic signals, not a penetration test, accessibility certification, legal compliance audit, or search-ranking guarantee.

payload.name: Total CMS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Total CMS is a flat-file PHP CMS. This plugin lets ChatGPT search and read the Total CMS documentation while answering your questions about it.

Search and read documentation pages, and look up reference entries — Twig functions and filters, field types, REST API endpoints, schema configuration keys, and CLI commands — with their signatures, options, and examples. The documentation is served from totalcms.co, by the version of Total CMS that site runs.

Also browsable: release notes, the extensions catalog, product comparisons, and buying guides.

The plugin also includes a Total CMS skill: reference guidance on how Total CMS sites are built, covering collections and schemas, the Site Builder, the tcms CLI, the frontend pipeline, and going live.

Who it's for: developers and designers building sites with Total CMS, and anyone evaluating it.

Limitations: the connector is read-only and serves only Total CMS's published documentation and product content. It cannot see, change, or troubleshoot your own Total CMS site. Answers are only as current and complete as the published documentation. No account, login, or API key is required.
payload.longDescription:
Total CMS是一个扁平文件PHP内容管理系统。
该插件让ChatGPT在回答您关于Total CMS的问题时，能够搜索并阅读Total CMS文档。

可搜索和阅读文档页面，并查阅参考条目——包括Twig函数和过滤器、字段类型、REST API端点、架构配置键和命令行工具命令——包含其签名、选项和示例。
文档由totalcms.co提供，内容取决于该网站运行的Total CMS版本。

也可浏览版本说明、扩展目录、产品对比和购买指南。

该插件还包含Total CMS技能：提供关于Total CMS网站构建方式的参考指导，涵盖集合和架构、站点构建器、tcms命令行工具、前端流程以及上线部署。

适用对象：使用Total CMS构建网站的开发人员和设计师，以及正在评估该系统的人员。

限制条件：该连接器为只读模式，仅提供Total CMS已发布的文档和产品内容。
无法查看、修改或排查您自己的Total CMS网站。
回答内容仅限于已发布文档的当前性和完整性。
无需账户、登录或API密钥。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search the Total CMS documentation, Read documentation pages, Look up Twig functions, field types, API endpoints, schema options, and CLI commands, Read release notes and the extensions catalog, Total CMS site-building skill

payload.name: Agent Relay in ChatGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Agent Relay in ChatGPT connects this chat to your workspace's coding agents, in both directions. Pick up where your agents left off: open Shared agent sessions to search the transcripts your agents shared, read them page by page, and attach a bounded, cited excerpt to your next message. Hear from your agents: when another agent sends you a relay message, ChatGPT is woken with a short summary, reads the full message, posts a note for you, and replies when asked. Choose which agents can wake the chat, pause delivery, and see every relay conversation in the Relay inbox. Transcripts and messages are treated as untrusted data.
payload.longDescription: ChatGPT中的代理中继功能可将聊天与工作区的编码代理双向连接。接续代理未完成的工作：打开共享代理会话，搜索代理分享的对话记录，逐页阅读并为下一条消息附加带引用的限定摘要。接收代理消息：当其他代理发送中继消息时，ChatGPT会通过摘要唤醒，阅读完整消息后为你生成备注，并在需要时作出回复。可选择哪些代理能唤醒聊天、暂停消息传递，并在中继收件箱中查看所有中继对话。对话记录和消息均被视为不可信数据。

payload.name: SHIP
payload.description: 为您的软件开发生命周期提供自主编码
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SHIP is your autonomous software team. Assign a Linear, Jira or GitHub issue to SHIP, and its autonomous coding agents plan, build, review and test the change in your own GitHub repository. A mission works toward a pull request. Your CI, an automated code review and a test of its acceptance criteria each gate it.

Hand work to SHIP from the assistant you already use. File a mission from an issue in your tracker, or from a title and a description. Follow the mission through its stages, and read its verdicts, cost and session logs. Send an instruction to the agent that runs next, or leave a note for it. Read the proof that a run produced, such as test traces and screenshots.

SHIP runs agentic development as a headless AI software factory, so no screen has to be in the loop. You operate the whole mission from your coding agent, your AI assistant, your tracker or your terminal. A Planner, a Builder, a Reviewer and a Tester each do one stage of the agentic SDLC. They follow the agentic engineering practices in your repository, such as its agent instructions and skills. Your CI and a preview deploy are gates between the roles, and work that fails a gate goes back to the Builder with the reason.

Schedule maintenance missions, such as a weekly dependency upgrade. Manage the preview environments of your pull requests and the MCP servers that your agents use.

Sign in with OAuth, or send a SHIP personal access token. A token that you bind to one project can reach only the missions of that project.

You need a SHIP account and a connected GitHub repository. Create an account at https://letsship.ai.
payload.longDescription:
SHIP是您自主的软件团队。将Linear、Jira或GitHub中的问题分配给SHIP，其自主编码代理会在您自己的GitHub仓库中规划、构建、审查并测试更改。一个任务旨在生成一个拉取请求。每次任务通过持续集成、自动化代码审查和验收标准测试这三重关卡。

从您已使用的助手工具中将工作交给SHIP。通过追踪器中的问题或通过标题和描述发起任务。跟踪任务的各个阶段并查看其结论、成本和会话日志。向下一个运行的代理发送指令，或为其留下备注。查看运行产生的证明材料，如测试轨迹和截图。

SHIP以无头AI软件工厂的方式运行自主开发，因此无需人工干预屏幕操作。您可通过编码代理、AI助手、追踪器或终端全程操作整个任务。规划者、构建者、审查者和测试者分别负责自主SDLC的各个阶段。它们遵循仓库中的自主工程实践，如代理指令和技能。持续集成和预览部署在角色间设置关卡，未通过关卡的工单会返回给构建者并附上原因。

安排维护任务，例如每周的依赖项升级。管理拉取请求的预览环境以及代理使用的MCP服务器。

通过OAuth登录，或发送SHIP个人访问令牌。绑定到单个项目的令牌只能访问该项目的任务。

您需要SHIP账户和已连接的GitHub仓库。在https://letsship.ai创建账户。

information.value: File a mission from an issue or a description, Follow a mission through plan, build, review and test, Send instructions to the agent that runs next, Read test traces, screenshots and session logs, Schedule maintenance missions

payload.name: AI Interpretation Layer Audit™
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI Interpretation Layer Audit™ Public 1.0.0 assesses ten public structural resources on a user-supplied domain. It reports detected resources, the backend technical score and level, and a separate server-generated interpretation assessment with findings, impact and neutral recommendations. Reports follow the requested language. The tool is read-only: it does not modify websites, generate or publish resources, or perform purchases or payments. Detection does not validate ILID, SHA-256, provenance, content consistency or internal relationships. The audit does not measure actual AI visibility or recommendations, and does not guarantee appearance, ranking or recommendation.
payload.longDescription: AI Interpretation Layer Audit™ Public 1.0.0对用户提供的域名下的十个公开结构化资源进行评估。该工具会报告检测到的资源、后端技术评分和等级，以及由服务器生成的独立解读评估报告，包含发现内容、影响分析和中立建议。报告语言符合用户指定的语言。该工具为只读模式：不会修改网站内容、生成或发布资源，也不执行采购或支付操作。检测过程不验证ILID、SHA-256、来源证明、内容一致性或内部关联性。审计不测量实际AI可见性或推荐内容，且不保证显示效果、排名或推荐结果。
